name: NLM Clinical Tables: ICD-10-CM
access: Free, no key, provided "as is" (2026 data)
use: Code lookup and autocomplete on the Diagnoses screen
privacyRule: Send code or standard term only

name: WHO ICD-API (ICD-11)
access: Free after registration. OAuth2 client credentials. Can also run as a local container
use: ICD-11 codes and multilingual titles for international users
privacyRule: Secret stays server-side. Local container option for offline use

name: LOINC
use: Tag measures for standards-based export

name: HL7 FHIR Questionnaire
endpoint: https://hl7.org/fhir (PCO IG has a GAD-7 Questionnaire)
use: Export a scored measure as a FHIR QuestionnaireResponse with no identifiers

name: MedlinePlus Connect
access: Free. Credit MedlinePlus.gov; no logo or implied endorsement
use: Plain-language pages matched by ICD-10-CM code, in English or Spanish

name: MedlinePlus Health Topics web service
use: Keyword search of health topics for client mode

name: RxNorm / RxTerms (NLM)
use: Psychotropic names for medication-referral education (clinician mode)

name: openFDA drug labels
use: Boxed warnings and label info for clinician reference

name: NPPES NPI Registry
access: Free. Max 200 results per request, 1,200 per query
use: Find psychiatrists, psychiatric NPs, psychologists, LPCs, LCSWs and LMFTs by taxonomy and ZIP

name: FindTreatment.gov API (SAMHSA)
access: Documented for approved users. Request access
use: Mental-health and SUD treatment facilities near a location
privacyRule: Location only. Show a "call to confirm" note (known data-quality issues)

name: HRSA data.hrsa.gov web services
use: Sliding-fee health centers by state, county or ZIP

name: 988 Lifeline / findahelpline.com
use: Crisis button, US and international

name: WHO Global Health Observatory
access: Public OData API. WHO announced a replacement implementation; confirm the current endpoint
use: Global statistic cards

name: NIMH statistics / SAMHSA NSDUH
use: US statistic cards (curated, dated)

name: PubMed E-utilities
access: Free; API key raises rate limit
use: Evidence links on each intervention (clinician mode)

name: LactMed (NCBI Bookshelf via E-utilities)
access: Free; NCBI E-utilities usage rules (shares the PubMed rate limit)
use: LactMed record link for a curated medication (clinician mode)

name: ClinicalTrials.gov API v2
use: Recruiting trials by condition (clinician mode)

name: NICE, APA Div. 12, WHO mhGAP, NCCIH
use: Evidence ratings, global guidance, complementary-care evidence

name: TherapistAid, CCI, Get Self Help, PHQ Screeners
use: Handout link-outs

name: Vercel hosting
access: HIPAA BAA for Pro teams as a paid add-on
use: Hosting once accounts exist
